content_of_post_to_comment: Unfiltered thought: The ones who reject denominational labels are often a bit proud to let you know that. I never quite understood the mindset of, “I'm not this or that denomination. I am a Christian.” Cool. I get that. We are Christ followers first, yes. But labels help me gauge your theology so I don't have to ask a million questions to figure that out. Also, non-denominational is just Baptist. Change my mind.
comment: The interesting tension is that labels can clarify doctrine but also become shortcuts for judgment. Perhaps the real issue isn't labels vs. no labels, but whether we use them as maps or as walls.
